title: Network Uptime Commitment Schedule, VPS and Dedicated Servers
content:
Every server in the VPS and Dedicated Servers range carries a monthly network uptime commitment, a credit rate for each started hour of network downtime beyond the commitment, and a cap on the credit for one month. The credit rate and the cap are percentages of the monthly fee.

| Tier | Monthly network uptime commitment (percent) | Credit per started hour of downtime beyond the commitment (percent of the monthly fee) | Largest credit for one month (percent of the monthly fee) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline VPS 2 GB | 99.9 | 5 | 100 |
| Harborline VPS 4 GB | 99.9 | 5 | 100 |
| Harborline VPS 8 GB | 99.9 | 5 | 100 |
| Harborline VPS 16 GB | 99.9 | 5 | 100 |
| Harborline Dedicated Standard | 99.95 | 5 | 100 |
| Harborline Dedicated Enterprise | 99.95 | 5 | 100 |

## Reading the schedule

- The two Harborline Dedicated tiers carry the higher commitment, 99.95 percent, against 99.9 percent on the four Harborline VPS tiers.
- The credit rate and the cap are the same on every tier: 5 percent of the monthly fee per started hour, and at most 100 percent of the monthly fee for one month, so the credit for a month can never exceed that month's fee.
